review.notes: Full re-review. All four round-4 findings repaired (supplier names re-pointed to section titles and declared IHG names; Layer 2 reduced to the §2.10 comparison; §§5.2/6.4 locators; Kisin JAMS pages). Gate rerun all zero OK; depcheck 243 roadmaps, 2481 edges, 0 problems; outside-folder diff empty. Suggested.lean elaborates with only the sorry warning; #check signatures match README §7.7; one-tactic probe (simp, rfl, infer_instance, simp_all, aesop) fails, so no padding. Seeded sample verified against cached texts: 1.7, 2.10 (Deligne–Serre), 3.2, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.14 (Carayol, Kisin JAMS, Skinner), 3.16 (Ribet 1975, Dasgupta–Kakde, BGV), 4.2 (Blasius), 4.10 (Skinner–Wiles), 6.2, 6.4a (DDT), 7.4 (Dimitrov, Newton–Thorne), 7.5 (Ribet 1985, Newton–Thorne). Findings: R01 P2 §1.7 uses a_p (Fourier coefficient) where eigenvalues are needed, making its polynomial and density-one rigidity claims false for E4 and for Delta(q^3) vs E4(q^3), and lacks the Deligne–Serre Cor. 6.3 locator; R02 P3 §§6.4a–6.6 restrict Sigma to Sigma_rhobar although DDT Lemmas 3.26–3.27 hold for every finite Sigma. Cross-roadmap citations resolved at open heads; no overlaps; adversarial table of 26 rows with computed values. One source misprint recorded (Blasius Prop. 5 proof normalization).
